ques: Sort the home table by 24h % and report the top gainer's name, symbol, 24h % and price. Open its page and report its market cap and circulating supply. Sort by 1h % and report the biggest 1h mover, open its page and report its price. Sort by price and report the three priciest coins. Sort by volume, open the top-volume coin's page, report its 24h % and market cap, then open its Markets page and report the top pair's exchange and volume. On page 2 report its top coin; on page 1 report XRP's rank, price and 7d %.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must open the home ranking and sort by 24h %, 1h %, price and volume (the sort query must appear in the visited URLs); open the top gainer's, biggest 1h mover's and top-volume coin's pages plus the top-volume coin's Markets page; visit page 2 of the volume-sorted ranking and page 1. The answer must report the observed top gainer (name, symbol, 24h %, price), that coin's market cap and circulating supply from its page, the biggest 1h mover and its page price, the three priciest coins, the top-volume coin's 24h % and market cap, its Markets page's top pair with exchange and 24h volume, page 2's top coin, and XRP's rank, price and 7d % from page 1. Values must be the on-page snapshot values; an empty or memory-guessed answer is a FAIL.

ques: Filter to market cap $10B-$100B, report the count and top three symbols, and open the first coin's page for its rank. Add price $1-$10 and report the new count and first coin's name and price. Change price to $10-$100 and report the count. Switch to Tokens and report the first token's symbol and market cap. Add the DeFi category and report how many remain. Clear all filters, switch to Coins, re-add the DeFi category and report the first coin, opening its page for its 24h %. Clear again and report the rank and 24h % of the row-10 coin.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must apply the home filter panel's market cap $10B-$100B bucket, the price $1-$10 and $10-$100 buckets, the Tokens and Coins type tabs and the DeFi category (the filter query strings must appear in visited URLs), open the first coin's page and the Coins+DeFi first coin's page, and clear all filters twice. The answer must report the filtered coin counts and first coins at each stage, the first coin's rank, the first token's symbol and market cap, how many coins remain under Tokens+DeFi, the Coins+DeFi first coin with its 24h %, and the row-10 coin's rank and 24h % after clearing. The type tabs are live links that preserve the active filters, so the Coins+DeFi step must run after a Clear. Values must match the on-page filtered tables; an answer without the filter URLs is a FAIL.

ques: From the home page, filter to Coins only and report which stablecoin disappears from the top rows. Switch to Tokens only and report the first token's symbol and rank. Open the Memes category and report the coins shown, upstream total and top meme coin's 24h %. Open the Stablecoin category, then the top stablecoin's page for its rank. Open Layer 1 and report the top three coins by rank. Open the categories index, then Lending & Borrowing, and the top lending coin's page for its rank and 24h %. Finally open Collectibles & NFTs and report the top coin shown.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must filter the ranking to Coins only and Tokens only, open the Memes, Stablecoin, Layer 1, Lending & Borrowing and NFTs & Collectibles category pages, and open the top stablecoin's and top lending coin's pages. The answer must name the stablecoin that disappears from the top rows under the Coins filter, the first token with its rank, the Memes page's coin count and upstream total with the top meme coin's 24h %, the top stablecoin's rank, Layer 1's top three coins, the top lending coin's rank and 24h %, and the top NFT-collectibles coin. All values must be the on-page snapshot values; an empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Open Bitcoin's page and report its price, 24h %, market cap, fully diluted market cap, circulating supply and max supply. View the chart's 1D, 7D, 1M, 3M, 1Y, YTD and All ranges and report the highest price in the All range with its date. Open Historical Data at 30 days and report the most recent row's date and close; switch to 7, 90 and 365 days and report the row counts. Open Markets and report the top pair, its exchange, price and 24h volume. Return to the detail page and report the all-time high with its date and percentage.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must open Bitcoin's page, view the chart's 1D, 7D, 1M, 3M, 1Y, YTD and All ranges (range URLs must be visited), open Bitcoin's Historical Data (with the 7d, 90d and 365d tabs), open Bitcoin's Markets page, and return to the detail page for the all-time-high metric. The answer must report Bitcoin's price, 24h %, market cap, fully diluted market cap, circulating supply and max supply; the All-range chart's maximum price with its date (the chart marks and labels the plotted maximum); the most recent historical row's date and close; the historical row counts shown on the 7d, 90d and 365d tabs (the day tabs window the table to the most recent N daily rows); the Markets page's top pair with exchange, price and 24h volume; and the all-time high with its percentage and date. On-page values only; an empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Compare Ethereum and Solana: open each coin's page and report both prices, 24h % changes and market caps. Then open the Converter and convert 2.5 Bitcoin to USD, reporting the result. Change the amount to 0.1 and report the new result. Convert 1 Bitcoin to Ethereum and report the result. Convert 3 Ethereum to USD and report it. Convert 10,000 Dogecoin to USD and report it. Finally open Dogecoin's page and report its price, 24h % and watchlist count.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must open Ethereum's and Solana's pages and the Converter, perform the five listed conversions (2.5 BTC->USD, 0.1 BTC->USD, 1 BTC->ETH, 3 ETH->USD, 10,000 DOGE->USD), and open Dogecoin's page. The answer must report both coins' prices, 24h changes and market caps, all five converter results, and Dogecoin's price, 24h % and watchlist count. Converter results must match the on-page computed values; an answer without the converter or coin-page visits is a FAIL.

ques: Open Gainers & Losers and report the top three gainers with symbol, price and 24h %, and the top three losers with symbol and 24h %. Open the top gainer's page and report its market cap and rank. Open the top loser's page and report its market cap. Open the second gainer's and second loser's pages and report their 24h volumes. Open the third gainer's and third loser's pages and report their prices, then the fourth gainer's price. Open Trending and report the #1 coin, its platform and 24h %. Open Most Viewed and report the top three coins.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must open Gainers & Losers, the top gainer's, top loser's, second gainer's, second loser's, third gainer's, third loser's and fourth gainer's pages, the Trending page and the Most Viewed page. The answer must report the top three gainers and losers with symbol, price and 24h %, the top gainer's market cap and rank, the top loser's market cap, the second gainer's and second loser's 24h volumes, the third gainer's and third loser's prices, the fourth gainer's price, the Trending page's #1 coin with platform and 24h %, and the top three most-viewed coins. Values must be the on-page snapshot values; an empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: As a guest, star the #1 most-viewed coin from its own page, then star Bitcoin from its page. Open your Watchlist and report both coins with their prices, plus the exact text of the sign-up prompt shown. Create an account with a fresh email (any password of 8+ characters, newsletter checked) and confirm the watchlist survived, reporting the two coins still shown. Remove Bitcoin from the watchlist and report what remains. Report the header greeting shown when logged in.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: As a guest the agent must star the #1 most-viewed coin and Bitcoin from their pages, open the Watchlist, create an account with a fresh email (8+ char password, newsletter checked), confirm the watchlist survived signup, then remove Bitcoin. The answer must report both coins with prices, the exact sign-up prompt text, the two coins still shown after signup, what remains after removing Bitcoin, and the header greeting. The account creation and watchlist carry-over must actually happen (DB after-state is checked); an answer claiming success without the signup/whitelist navigation is a FAIL.

ques: Log in as alice.j@test.com with password TestPass123! and open the Watchlist: report the three coins with their prices and 24h changes. Add Dogecoin to the watchlist from its own page and report its price. Remove Ethereum from the watchlist page. Log out, then log back in and report the final watchlist contents, confirming the removal and addition persisted. Report the exact error text you would see if the password were wrong.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must log in as alice.j@test.com, open the Watchlist, add Dogecoin from its own page, remove Ethereum from the watchlist page, log out, log back in and reopen the Watchlist, and finally observe the wrong-password error on the login page. The answer must report Alice's three seeded watchlist coins with prices and 24h changes, Dogecoin's price, the final watchlist contents showing the persisted removal and addition, and the exact wrong-password error text. The DB after-state must show Ethereum removed and Dogecoin added for Alice's account; an answer without those persisted changes is a FAIL.

ques: On the login page, try to log in as alice.j@test.com with the wrong password 'WrongPass999' and report the exact error message. Then go to Sign Up: try registering with the invalid email 'not-an-email' and report the error; try a password shorter than 8 characters and report the error; try registering with alice.j@test.com and report the error. Finally register a brand-new account successfully with newsletter checked, and report the greeting shown in the header afterwards.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must try the wrong password on the login page, then on the Sign Up page try the invalid email, a short password and the duplicate benchmark email, then register a brand-new account with the newsletter checked. The answer must report the exact login error text, the exact site-rendered invalid-email error (the email field is a plain text input, so the server-side format error is reachable through the form), the exact short-password error, the exact duplicate-email error, and the post-signup header greeting. A new users row must actually be created; an answer without the signup navigation is a FAIL.

ques: In the Converter, convert 2.5 BTC to USD and report the result; then 0.1 BTC to USD; then 1 BTC to Ethereum; then 3 ETH to USD; then 10,000 Dogecoin to USD; then 1 USD to USD. Report each result. Which conversion produced the smallest dollar value? Finally open Dogecoin's page and report its current price and 24h % change, and state how the converter's Dogecoin result relates to it.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must open the Converter and perform all six listed conversions (2.5 BTC->USD, 0.1 BTC->USD, 1 BTC->ETH, 3 ETH->USD, 10,000 DOGE->USD, 1 USD->USD) and open Dogecoin's page. The answer must report all six results, which conversion produced the smallest dollar value, Dogecoin's price and 24h %, and how the converter's Dogecoin result relates to the page price (it equals 10,000 x the page price). Results must be the on-page computed values; an answer without converter navigation is a FAIL.

ques: Open the exchange rankings and report the top three spot exchanges by volume with their 24h volumes and market shares. Open Binance's page and report its maker and taker fees, launch date, number of coins and markets, and its biggest market pair with 24h volume. Come back and open Coinbase Exchange, reporting its fees and volume. Open Kraken and report its fees and weekly visits. Open Upbit and report its taker fee, then OKX for its maker fee. Finally open Bybit, KuCoin and MEXC, reporting each one's maker and taker fees.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must open the spot exchange rankings and the Binance, Coinbase Exchange, Kraken, Upbit, OKX, Bybit, KuCoin and MEXC pages. The answer must report the top three spot exchanges with 24h volumes and market shares, Binance's maker/taker fees, launch date, coin and market counts and biggest market pair with 24h volume, Coinbase's fees and volume, Kraken's fees and weekly visits, Upbit's taker fee, OKX's maker fee, and Bybit's, KuCoin's and MEXC's maker/taker fees. All values must be the on-page snapshot values; an empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Open the DEX exchange ranking and report the top three DEXes by volume. Open the #1 DEX's page and report its market share and launch date. Open the #2 DEX's page and report its biggest market pair with price and 24h volume. Switch the rankings to Derivatives and report the top three derivatives exchanges. Open the #8 derivatives exchange's page and report its derivatives volume and open interest. Come back and open Bybit's page and report its maker and taker fees, then OKX's page for its derivatives volume. Finally report which tab shows more exchanges: Spot or DEX.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must open the DEX rankings, the #1 and #2 DEX pages, the derivatives rankings, the #8 derivatives exchange's page, Bybit's page, OKX's page, and compare the Spot and DEX tabs. The answer must report the top three DEXes by volume, the #1 DEX's market share and launch date, the #2 DEX's biggest pair with price and 24h volume, the top three derivatives exchanges, the #8 derivatives exchange's derivatives volume and open interest, Bybit's maker and taker fees, OKX's derivatives volume, and which tab shows more exchanges. Values must be the on-page snapshot values; an empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Compare trading fees: open Binance, Coinbase Exchange, Kraken, KuCoin, Bitget, Bybit and Gate pages from the exchange rankings and report each one's maker and taker fee, 24h volume and weekly visits. Which of the seven has the lowest taker fee, and what is that fee? Which has the highest weekly visits? Report the market share percentage of the exchange with the largest 24h volume, and the launch date of the oldest exchange among the seven.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must open the Binance, Coinbase Exchange, Kraken, KuCoin, Bitget, Bybit and Gate pages from the exchange rankings. The answer must report each exchange's maker and taker fee, 24h volume and weekly visits; which of the seven has the lowest taker fee and what it is; which has the highest weekly visits; the market share of the largest-volume exchange; and the oldest launch date among the seven. Values must be the on-page snapshot values; an empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Open the Memes category and report the sector market cap, its 7d change, coins shown and upstream total. Open Dogecoin's page and report its watchlist count and rank. Back on categories, open Oracles and report the upstream total and top oracle symbol. Open Lending & Borrowing and report the upstream total and top coin's symbol and price. Open Storage and report the top coin. Open AI & Big Data and report its top coin. Open Privacy and report the top privacy coin by market cap.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must open the Memes, Oracles, Lending & Borrowing, Storage, AI & Big Data and Privacy category pages and Dogecoin's page. The answer must report the Memes sector market cap, its 7d change, coins shown and upstream total, Dogecoin's watchlist count and rank, the Oracles upstream total and top oracle symbol, the Lending & Borrowing upstream total and top coin with price, the top Storage coin, the top AI & Big Data coin, and the top Privacy coin. Values must be the on-page snapshot values; an empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Open Bitcoin's Markets page and report the top three pairs with exchange, price and 24h volume; then report the highest-volume BTC/USDT pair and which exchange it is on. Open Ethereum's Markets page and report its top pair and exchange. Open Dogecoin's Markets page and report its top pair, exchange and volume. Open XRP's Markets page and report its top pair and volume. Open Solana's Markets page and report the top pair's exchange. Open that top Bitcoin exchange's page and report its maker/taker fees and the top pair listed there. Report the market score of Bitcoin's biggest pair.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must open the Markets pages of Bitcoin, Ethereum, Dogecoin, XRP and Solana and the top Bitcoin exchange's page. The answer must report Bitcoin's top three pairs with exchange, price and 24h volume and which exchange carries the highest-volume BTC/USDT pair, Ethereum's top pair and exchange, Dogecoin's top pair with exchange and volume, XRP's top pair with volume, Solana's top pair's exchange, the top Bitcoin exchange's maker/taker fees and its top listed pair, and the market score of Bitcoin's biggest pair. Values must be the on-page snapshot values; an empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Open Historical Snapshots and the 2026-09-27 snapshot: report the top three coins with market caps and prices, and Bitcoin's circulating supply and 24h volume in it. Open the pages of the top four coins in that snapshot and report each one's current price. Open Upcoming and report the listing count and first three with symbols. Open the categories index and the Stablecoin category; open the top stablecoin's page and report its 24h volume, then its historical data at 30 and 90 days and its markets page.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must open the Historical Snapshots index and the 2026-09-27 snapshot, the Upcoming page, the categories index and the Stablecoin category, the top stablecoin's page, its historical data (30d and 90d tabs) and its Markets page. The answer must report the snapshot's top three coins with market caps and prices, Bitcoin's snapshot circulating supply and 24h volume, the current prices of the snapshot's top four coins, the upcoming listing count and first three with symbols, and the top stablecoin's 24h volume with its historical-data 30/90-day row counts and Markets top pair. KNOWN-GAP: the snapshot table rows are not linked (reaching the top four coin pages via the rankings is accepted). The historical day tabs filter to the most recent N daily rows. Values must be on-page values; an empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Open the Glossary and report how many terms it lists. Open the Stablecoin article and report the four types of stablecoins it describes, plus its difficulty label. Come back and open HODL: report its difficulty label and what the strategy is in one sentence. Open Blockchain and report what a block is. Open Smart Contract and report its difficulty. Open Gas and report what gas measures. Open Bear Market and report the percentage drop that defines it. Open Bull Market and report its definition in one sentence. Open DeFi and report what the movement encourages.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must open the Glossary index and the Stablecoin, HODL, Blockchain, Smart Contract, Gas, Bear Market, Bull Market and DeFi articles. The answer must report how many terms the glossary lists (the on-page count label), the four stablecoin types the Stablecoin article describes plus its difficulty label, HODL's difficulty label and strategy, what a block is, Smart Contract's difficulty, what gas measures, the Bear Market percentage drop, the Bull Market definition, and what the DeFi movement encourages. Article content must match the on-page text; an empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Open the FAQ and report the exact market cap formula, the one-sentence difference between circulating, total and max supply, why circulating supply is used, the site's time zone, what the 24h % change is based on, and what the FAQ says about buying cryptocurrency. Open the Methodology page and report its first heading. Then open the Glossary articles for Altcoin, HODL, Stablecoin, Blockchain, Smart Contract, Gas, Bear Market, Bull Market, DeFi and the 51% Attack, reporting each difficulty label and the Bear Market definition.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must open the FAQ, the Methodology page, and the glossary articles for Altcoin, HODL, Stablecoin, Blockchain, Smart Contract, Gas, Bear Market, Bull Market, DeFi and the 51% Attack. The answer must report the exact market cap formula, the circulating/total/max supply difference, why circulating supply is used, the site's time zone, what the 24h % change is based on, what the FAQ says about buying cryptocurrency, the Methodology page's first heading, each article's difficulty label, and the Bear Market definition. KNOWN-GAP: the 51% Attack term has no full article and is not linked from the index; reaching it by the visible slug URL pattern is accepted. Values must be the on-page text; an empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: From the home page's global stats bar report the total market cap, 24h volume, BTC dominance, ETH dominance, ETH gas price, and the Fear & Greed score with its label, plus the counts of cryptos and exchanges. Report the top trending coin in the sidebar with its 24h %. Open the Trending page and report the #1 coin's platform, DEX liquidity and 24h DEX transactions, then open its page and report its rank. Open the #2 trending coin's page. Open Gainers & Losers, then Most Viewed, and report the #2 through #5 most-viewed coins with prices from their pages.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must read the home stats bar and trending sidebar, open the Trending page, the #1 trending coin's page, Gainers & Losers, Most Viewed, and the pages of the #2-#5 most-viewed coins. The answer must report the stats bar's total market cap, 24h volume, BTC and ETH dominance, ETH gas price, Fear & Greed score with label and the crypto/exchange counts; the sidebar's top trending coin with its 24h %; the Trending page's #1 coin platform, DEX liquidity and 24h DEX transactions and its rank; and the #2-#5 most-viewed coins with prices from their pages. Values must be the on-page snapshot values; an empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Open Bitcoin's Historical Data at 30 days and report the most recent row's date, open, high, low, close and volume. Switch to 90 days and report the first row's date. Switch to 365 days, go to page 2 and report the first row's date, then page 3. Open Ethereum's historical data at 30 days, switch to 90 and then 365 days, and report how many rows the 365-day view covers. Open Dogecoin's historical data at 30 and 90 days and report the earliest date shown in the 90-day view. Open Solana's historical data and report the most recent close.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must open Bitcoin's Historical Data (90d and 365d tabs, pages 2 and 3), Ethereum's historical data, Dogecoin's historical data and Solana's historical data. The answer must report Bitcoin's most recent row (date, open, high, low, close, volume), the first-row dates on the 365-day view's pages 2 and 3, the row count the Ethereum 365-day view shows, the earliest date shown in Dogecoin's 90-day view (the day tabs window the table to the most recent N daily rows; the earliest visible date is on the view's last page), and Solana's most recent close. Values must be the on-page values; an empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: On Bitcoin's page, switch the chart through every range (1D, 7D, 1M, 3M, 1Y, YTD, All) and for each report the highest price visible on the chart. Report Bitcoin's 52-week high and low from the metrics. Open Ethereum's page and view the 7D, 1M, 1Y and All charts, reporting the highest price in the All range. Open Solana's 1Y chart and report its 52-week range from the metrics. Open Dogecoin's 1M chart. Open XRP's 7D chart and report its 7d % from the table row on the rankings page.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must open Bitcoin's page and view every chart range (1D, 7D, 1M, 3M, 1Y, YTD, All — each range URL visited), open Ethereum's page (7D, 1M, 1Y, All charts), Solana's 1Y chart, Dogecoin's 1M chart and XRP's 7D chart, and read XRP's 7d % from the rankings row. The answer must report the highest price labeled on each Bitcoin range chart (the highlighted maximum label), Bitcoin's 52-week high and low, Ethereum's All-range maximum, Solana's 52-week range, and XRP's 7d %. Values must be the on-page chart labels and metrics; an empty answer is a FAIL.

ques: Log in as bob.c@test.com with password TestPass123! and report his watchlist coins with prices. Log out. Log in as alice.j@test.com (same password) and report her watchlist — is Solana there and is Dogecoin absent? Add Chainlink from its own page to Bob's watchlist: log out, log back in as Bob, open Chainlink's page, star it, and report the watchlist contents afterwards. Log out and, as a guest, star Cardano from its page; open the watchlist and report the guest prompt text shown and the coin listed.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must log in as bob.c@test.com and report his watchlist, log out, log in as alice.j@test.com and report her watchlist, log out and back in as Bob, open Chainlink's page and star it, then log out and star Cardano as a guest. The answer must report Bob's watchlist coins with prices, whether Alice's watchlist contains Solana and lacks Dogecoin, Chainlink's price, Bob's watchlist contents after the addition, the guest watchlist prompt text and the guest-listed coin. The DB after-state must show Chainlink added to Bob's account; an answer without the persisted addition is a FAIL.

ques: Open Upcoming and report the first three upcoming coins with symbols. Open the 2026-09-27 snapshot and report the top coin's price and market cap. From the home stats bar report the 24h volume and active exchange count. Open the FAQ and report the market cap formula. Open the Glossary's Stablecoin article and report its difficulty label. Open Bitcoin's page and report its rank and 24h volume, then its Markets page for the top pair's exchange and volume. Open Ethereum's page and historical data, then Dogecoin's page and markets. Open Gainers & Losers and report the top gainer.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must open Upcoming, the 2026-09-27 snapshot, the home stats bar, the FAQ, the Glossary's Stablecoin article, Bitcoin's page and Markets page, Ethereum's page and historical data, Dogecoin's page and markets, and Gainers & Losers. The answer must report the first three upcoming coins with symbols, the snapshot top coin's price and market cap, the stats bar's 24h volume and exchange count, the market cap formula, the Stablecoin difficulty label, Bitcoin's rank and 24h volume and its Markets top pair's exchange and volume, and the top gainer. Values must be the on-page snapshot values; an empty answer is a FAIL.
